candidates.name: tabler
candidates.value: ready-made responsive dashboard shell, cards, status badges and dark mode
risks: full repository is a pnpm/turbo monorepo
copying the whole build system would add unnecessary runtime and dependency surface
candidates.recommendation: copy only the small shell/token/card subset or compiled assets after scope approval

candidates.name: jkanban
candidates.value: vanilla JavaScript Kanban columns with drag/drop callbacks and no framework runtime
risks: drag/drop callbacks must remain read-only in the first dashboard version
Apache notice must follow any copied files
candidates.recommendation: defer vendoring until the read model is correct; prefer own read-only card renderer first

decision.recommended_scope: freeze the discussion plan first; then use Tabler shell and only add jKanban if interactive columns are explicitly needed
decision.rationale: The current failure is first a canonical-root/read-model problem. A UI library can improve layout but cannot fix cross-worktree service drift, historical filtering or missing names.
decision.next_adoption_gate: User confirms the plan decisions in 10_plans/active/20260924_dashboard-and-plan-upgrade/plan_index.json
